name: informal-logic-check
description: An Agent Skill that runs before the agent disagrees with, qualifies or pushes back on the user's argument, whenever the user insults or swears at it, and before it considers ending the conversation. It audits the agent's last output for straw-manning, cherry-picking, caveat earmarking, grading, burden-shifting, attributed emotions, unverified authority, rule violations and instruction drift; confirms the user's conclusion and premises in the user's words; then evaluates the confirmed set only.
